data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior
Deterministic CI tests pass on every run when no code change affects them.

#### Actual Behavior
Observed during session 2026-05-17 on PR #213 (branch fix/code-reviewer-b-design-defect):

* Cycle 1 run A (commit c4eabb95): test-merge-to-main.sh fails with 'test_state_init_creates_json_with_schema' / 'test_state_merge_sha_recorded' — 'python parse error'
* Cycle 1 run B (same commit, re-run): all tests pass
* Cycle 2 run A (commit 3850ea94, per-branch-review.yml's Script Tests): test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh fails 'test_version_bump_marks_state_complete' / 'test_version_bump_phase_marks_state_complete' (expected: 'version_bump', actual: 'no_state_file')
* Cycle 2 run B (same commit, ci.yml's Script Tests): all tests pass

Same-commit runs producing different outcomes — definitive intermittent failures.

Both failures are in merge-to-main internals (test-merge-to-main.sh and test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh). State-file marking and JSON parsing both appear timing/race sensitive.

Related: bug f127-03ef-fd14-4da1 (LLM review duplication) — the duplicated Script Tests runs make the intermittency more visible because one of the two coin flips fails often enough to block CI even when the other succeeds.

### 4. Proposed Fix (cluster mode)

Treat as a CLUSTER per /dso:fix-bug Cluster Investigation Mode:
1. test-merge-to-main.sh::test_state_init_creates_json_with_schema — 'python parse error' on state file init
2. test-merge-to-main.sh::test_state_merge_sha_recorded — 'python parse error' on state file read after merge
3. test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh::test_version_bump_marks_state_complete — state file missing after _phase_version_bump
4. test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh::test_version_bump_phase_marks_state_complete — same root cause

Common surface: state file lifecycle in merge-to-main pipeline tests. Likely shared root cause around fixture cleanup, parallel test execution, or fork-from-template fixture race.

### 5. Skills and Workflows
* tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main.sh
* tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-version-bump.sh
* Possibly: plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (state file lifecycle)

### 6. Logs
Run links:
* https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26012477057/job/76455840695 (Script Tests cycle 2 run A — failed)
* https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26012477912/job/76455941204 (Script Tests cycle 2 run B — passed)
